name: Me, the Immortal
oracle_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put your choice of a +1/+1, first strike, vigilance, or menace counter on Me.
Counters remain on Me as it moves to any zone other than a player's hand or library.
You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding two cards in addition to paying its other costs.
blocked_sentences: Counters remain on Me as it moves to any zone other than a player's hand or library.

needs.what: a card-level rule that the object keeps its counters when it changes zones (battlefield to graveyard, exile, stack, and back onto the battlefield as a permanent), dropping them only when it goes to a hand or library -- so the card stays the same object for counter purposes across rule 400.7, including keyword counters (first strike, vigilance, menace) and +1/+1 counters it re-enters with after being cast from the graveyard
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No card_level_rider_key, static effect or replacement carries counters through a zone change. enters_with_additional_counters / spell_enters_with_counters / return_from_graveyard.counters put a fixed printed set of counters, not whatever counters the object had; snapshot and counters_had read a last-known value inside one resolution but nothing stores counters on a card in the graveyard or on the stack and re-applies them when it enters
